decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - It is considered that this application for the construction of a two-storey side extension, and single-storey rear extension  the dwelling house at 111 Roxborough Avenue would not harm the appearance the existing building or the character of the surrounding area, and would protect neighbours' living conditions. The proposal is considered to be in accordance with Policies ENV B.1.1 (New Development), and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) within the Unitary Development Plan, and the relevant provisions of the Residential Extension Guidelines .
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the extensions are used.
Condition : 5 - The extension hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 111 Roxborough Avenue.

Condition : 6 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the east and west walls of the extensions hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a two storey side and single storey rear  extension to existing house
